english: For each positive integer $n$, let $x_n=\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n}\frac{2}{(2j-1)(2j+1)}$, and let $S=\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x_{n+1}-x_n}{1+x_nx_{n+1}}\right)$, where $\tan^{-1}$ takes values in $\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$. Then the value of $\tan S$ is ______.
hindi: प्रत्येक धनात्मक पूर्णांक $n$ के लिए माना $x_n=\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{n}\frac{2}{(2j-1)(2j+1)}$ है, तथा $S=\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x_{n+1}-x_n}{1+x_nx_{n+1}}\right)$ है, जहाँ $\tan^{-1}$ के मान $\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{2},\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)$ में हैं। तब $\tan S$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Partial fractions: $\dfrac{2}{(2j-1)(2j+1)}=\dfrac1{2j-1}-\dfrac1{2j+1}$, so the sum telescopes and $x_n=1-\dfrac1{2n+1}=\dfrac{2n}{2n+1}$.

For $a,b$ with $ab>-1$, $\tan^{-1}a-\tan^{-1}b=\tan^{-1}\dfrac{a-b}{1+ab}$ (principal values). Here $x_nx_{n+1}>0$, so each term equals $\tan^{-1}x_{n+1}-\tan^{-1}x_n$, a positive number less than $\dfrac\pi4$.
originality_note: New: a two-level telescoping, in which the arguments of the inverse tangents are built from a sequence that is itself a telescoping sum with linear factors; the sum of the series is a difference of two inverse tangents (way 5: linear-denominator telescoping feeding an inverse-tangent telescoping). Closest known: 'sum tan^{-1}(1/(1 + n + n^2))' (listed known skeleton). Different because: the arguments come from x_n = 2n/(2n+1), so the split points are not 1/n, and x_n must be found first.
blueprint_concepts: Sum of a telescopic series whose nth term is product of linear factors in denominator
Summation of series based on ITF

concept_use.Summation of series based on ITF: tan^{-1} a - tan^{-1} b = tan^{-1}((a - b)/(1 + ab)) for ab > -1 makes the series telescope to pi/4 - tan^{-1}(2/3).
